selection_reason: Logistic Regression was selected because it provides a direct probability for the application's risk score while remaining close to the Linear SVM benchmark.
notes: Only datasets containing both classes were used for the main supervised training corpus.
Nazario and Nigerian_Fraud were inspected but excluded from the main training split because they contain only positive labels.
The email model is separate from the URL model.
Linked URLs are independently scanned by the URL analysis engine.
Metrics are holdout metrics and are not a guarantee of production performance.
